rules.statement: PARA_NUM_REGS sets the number of read/write registers, default 8, with legal values 1 to 16.
PARA_ADDR_W sets the width in bits of i_s_axi_awaddr and i_s_axi_araddr, default 8, legal values 7 to 16.
LPARA_REGS_W is derived as PARA_NUM_REGS*32 and is the width of o_regs in bits (32 for 1 register, 256 default, 512 for 16).

rules.condition: For every combination of PARA_NUM_REGS from 1 to 16 and PARA_ADDR_W from 7 to 16
rules.statement: The block must behave as the specification states for every legal combination of PARA_NUM_REGS (1 to 16) and PARA_ADDR_W (7 to 16).
LPARA_REGS_W shall be a local parameter equal to PARA_NUM_REGS*32 that cannot be overridden from outside the module.

rules.condition: PARA_NUM_REGS or PARA_ADDR_W is outside its legal range
rules.statement: The RTL should stop elaboration with an error message when PARA_NUM_REGS or PARA_ADDR_W is outside its legal range.
Behaviour with illegal parameter values is unspecified and must not be verified.
